rules: @font-face { font-family: "BMS Instrument"; src: url("assets/fonts/instrument-serif/InstrumentSerif-Regular.ttf") format("truetype"); font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; }
@font-face { font-family: "BMS Instrument"; src: url("assets/fonts/instrument-serif/InstrumentSerif-Italic.ttf") format("truetype"); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-display: swap; }
body.home { --focus-paper: #e4e3dc; --focus-ink: #0c0e0f; --focus-white: #fffdf9; --focus-signal: #f3350c; --focus-serif: 'BMS Instrument',Georgia,serif; background: var(--focus-paper); }
body.home main { padding: 0px !important; }
body.home .entry-content { max-width: none; width: 100%; margin: 0px; }
body.home .entry-content > .wp-block-group { margin: 0px; width: 100%; scroll-margin-top: 100px; max-width: none !important; }
body.home .entry-content :where(.bms-heading, .bms-copy, .bms-focus-note, .bms-panel-note) { margin-block: 0px; }
body.home .bms-heading { font: 400 72px/1 var(--focus-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--focus-ink); text-wrap: balance; }
body.home .bms-heading em { font-weight: 400; }
body.home .bms-copy { font: 400 14px / 1.5 Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--focus-ink); max-width: 62ch; }
body.home .bms-focus-note, body.home .bms-panel-note { font: 400 12px / 1.6 Arial, sans-serif; }

body.home .bms-focus-link .wp-block-button__link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 25px; background: var(--focus-white); color: var(--focus-ink); border-radius: 40px; padding: 17px 22px; font: 600 12px / 1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; min-height: 46px; text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; }
body.home .bms-focus-link .wp-block-button__link::after { content: ""; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--focus-signal); flex: 0 0 auto; transition: transform 0.35s; }
body.home .bms-focus-link .wp-block-button__link:hover::after { transform: scale(1.7); }
body.home .bms-focus-link .wp-block-button__link:focus-visible, body.home #header a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-signal); outline-offset: 5px; }
body.home .bms-roll { display: inline-grid; overflow: hidden; line-height: 1.2; vertical-align: middle; }
body.home .bms-roll > span { grid-area: 1 / 1; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.5s; }
body.home .bms-roll > span + span { transform: translateY(120%); opacity: 0; }
body.home a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .bms-roll > span:first-child { transform: translateY(-120%); opacity: 0; }
body.home a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .bms-roll > span + span { transform: translateY(0px); opacity: 1; }
body.home #header { left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 100%; z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; position: absolute !important; }
body.home #header [data-device] { pointer-events: none; }
body.home #header [data-row] { background: transparent; border: 0px; }
body.home #header [data-row="middle"] { width: min(860px, 100% - 48px); margin: auto; background: rgba(17, 27, 34, 0.93); border-radius: 0px 0px 32px 32px; pointer-events: auto; --height: 78px; }
body.home #header [data-row] .ct-container { width: 100%; padding: 0px 28px; gap: 18px; }
body.home #header .site-title { letter-spacing: -0.02em; max-width: 220px; color: white !important; font: 400 25px/1 var(--focus-serif) !important; }
body.home #header .site-title a { color: white !important; }
body.home #header .menu a, body.home #header .ct-header-cta a, body.home #header .ct-header-trigger { font: 600 11px / 1.25 Arial, sans-serif; color: white !important; }
body.home #header .ct-header-cta a { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 30px; min-height: 38px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0px !important; }
body.home #header .ct-header-trigger svg { fill: white; }
body.home #header .menu > li > a::before, body.home #header .menu > li > a::after { display: none; }
body.home #offcanvas { --theme-text-color: #fffdf9; --theme-link-initial-color: #fffdf9; --theme-link-hover-color: #f3350c; }
body.home #offcanvas .ct-panel-inner { background: rgb(17, 27, 34); color: white; }
body.home #offcanvas a { color: white; }
body.home .bms-focus-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.45fr 1fr; gap: 9vw; align-items: center; padding: 48px 32px; background: var(--focus-paper); }
body.home .bms-focus-visual { margin: 0px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 64px; background: rgb(216, 209, 198); height: 622px; }
body.home .bms-focus-visual img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
body.home #what-you-get .bms-focus-visual img { object-fit: contain; }
body.home .bms-focus-copy { padding-right: 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; }
body.home .bms-focus-copy .bms-heading { margin-bottom: 8px; }
body.home .bms-focus-copy .wp-block-buttons { margin: 0px; }
body.home .bms-preview-chapter { background: var(--focus-paper); padding: 0px 0px 64px; }
body.home .bms-focus-photo-panel { position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-height: 754px; padding: 70px 7vw; display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgb(78, 70, 59); }
body.home .bms-panel-background { position: absolute; inset: 0px; z-index: -1; margin: 0px; overflow: hidden; }
body.home .bms-panel-background img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 45%; }

body.home .bms-dark-panel { width: 490px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 32px; background: rgba(23, 27, 28, 0.9); color: white; padding: 42px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
body.home .bms-dark-panel .bms-heading { color: white; }
body.home .bms-dark-panel .bms-copy, body.home .bms-dark-panel .bms-panel-note { color: rgb(240, 238, 233); }
body.home .bms-preview-surface { max-width: 1168px; margin: 48px auto 0px; padding: 0px 24px; }
body.home .bms-how .bms-focus-visual { height: 590px; }
body.home .bms-contained-cover { padding: 28px 80px; background: rgb(212, 209, 198); }
body.home .bms-contained-cover img { object-fit: contain; }
body.home .bms-focus-steps { counter-reset: journey 0; }
body.home .bms-focus-steps .bms-copy { counter-increment: journey 1; padding: 15px 0px 15px 36px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(191, 190, 181); position: relative; font-size: 13px; }
body.home .bms-focus-steps .bms-copy::before { content: counter(journey, decimal-leading-zero); position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 15px; font: italic 21px var(--focus-serif); }
body.home .bms-focus-steps strong { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.9; }
body.home .bms-panel-right { justify-content: flex-end; }
body.home .bms-focus-price { font: 400 40px/1 var(--focus-serif); color: white; margin: 0px; }
body.home .bms-offer .wp-block-buttons { margin: 0px; }
body.home .bms-faq { padding: 80px 7vw; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr; gap: 8vw; background: var(--focus-paper); }
body.home .bms-focus-faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px 38px; }
body.home .bms-focus-question .bms-heading { font: 600 14px / 1.3 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0px; margin: 0px 0px 12px; }
body.home .bms-focus-question .bms-copy { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; }
body.home .bms-samples { background: var(--focus-paper); padding: 64px 24px 120px; text-align: center; }
body.home .bms-samples > .bms-heading { font-size: 96px; line-height: 0.98; margin-bottom: 26px; }
body.home .bms-samples > .bms-copy { margin: 0px auto 75px; }

body.home .bms-focus-card { position: relative; max-width: 1280px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; margin: 0px auto 80px; border-radius: 32px; overflow: hidden; background: rgb(209, 206, 194); transform-origin: 50% 50%; will-change: auto; }
body.home .bms-focus-card:last-child { margin-bottom: 0px; }
body.home .bms-focus-card figure { height: 100%; margin: 0px; }
body.home .bms-focus-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

body.home .bms-card-label { position: absolute; left: 24px; bottom: 24px; margin: 0px; border-radius: 30px; background: white; color: rgb(12, 14, 15); font: 12px / 1 Arial, sans-serif; padding: 9px 14px; }
body.home .bms-card-label::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; background: var(--focus-signal); border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 8px; }
body.home .bms-closing { position: relative; isolation: isolate; background: rgb(8, 10, 11); min-height: 1050px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 150px 32px; overflow: clip; }
body.home .bms-closing-copy { position: relative; text-align: center; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 32px; z-index: 2; }
body.home .bms-closing .bms-heading { font-size: clamp(80px, 9vw, 132px); color: white; line-height: 1; max-width: 1000px; }
body.home .bms-closing .bms-copy { color: rgb(212, 212, 206); }
body.home .bms-closing .wp-block-buttons { margin: 0px; }
body.home .bms-closing-photo { position: absolute; width: 200px; height: 245px; border-radius: 28px; overflow: hidden; margin: 0px; z-index: 1; }
body.home .bms-closing-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
body.home .bms-closing-photo-left { left: 4vw; top: 18%; }
body.home .bms-closing-photo-right { right: 4vw; bottom: 13%; }
body.home .bms-brand-footer { background: rgb(8, 10, 11); color: white; }
body.home .bms-brand-footer h2 { font-family: var(--focus-serif); letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
body.home #footer [data-row="bottom"] { background: rgb(8, 10, 11); border-color: rgb(52, 54, 56); }
body.home ::selection { background: rgb(243, 53, 12); color: white; }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-reveal.bms-in-view { animation: 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0s 1 normal both running bms-section-entry; }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-card { transform: perspective(1600px) translateY(var(--card-y,0px)) translateZ(var(--card-depth,0px)) rotateX(var(--card-tilt,0deg)) scale(var(--card-scale,1)); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-panel-background img { position: relative; top: -180px; height: calc(100% + 360px); transform: translateY(var(--photo-y,0px)); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-visual { clip-path: inset(var(--split-inset,0%) round 32px); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-visual img { transform: translateY(var(--split-y,0px)) scale(var(--split-scale,1)); transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-copy { transform: translateY(var(--copy-y,0px)); opacity: var(--copy-opacity,1); }

children: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing { height: 190svh; min-height: 1600px; display: block; padding: 0px; overflow: clip; }

body.home .bms-closing-sticky { position: sticky; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100svh; min-height: 700px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 80px 32px; isolation: isolate; max-width: none !important; margin: 0px !important; }

rules: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing-photo-left { transform: translateY(var(--closing-left,0px)); opacity: var(--closing-left-opacity,1); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing-photo-right { transform: translateY(var(--closing-right,0px)); opacity: var(--closing-right-opacity,1); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing .bms-heading { clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--closing-reveal,100%)) 0 0); color: white; }

children: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-panel-background img { top: 0px; height: 100%; transform: none; }
body.home #offcanvas .ct-panel-inner { inset: 80px 24px auto auto; width: calc(100% - 48px); height: auto; max-height: calc(-100px + 100svh); min-height: 0px; border-radius: 24px; overflow: auto; }
body.home .bms-focus-split { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; padding: 28px 24px 36px; }
body.home .bms-closing { min-height: 560px; padding: 65px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
body.home .bms-focus-visual img, body.home .bms-focus-copy { transform: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
body.home .bms-focus-card, body.home .bms-panel-background img, body.home .bms-closing-photo { transform: none !important; }
body.home a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .bms-roll > span:first-child { transform: none; opacity: 1; }

body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-visual img { transform: translateY(var(--split-y,0px)) scale(var(--split-scale,1)); transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-focus-copy { transform: translateY(var(--copy-y,0px)); opacity: var(--copy-opacity,1); }

children: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing { height: 190svh; min-height: 1600px; display: block; padding: 0px; overflow: clip; }

body.home .bms-closing-sticky { position: sticky; top: 0px; width: 100%; height: 100svh; min-height: 700px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 80px 32px; isolation: isolate; max-width: none !important; margin: 0px !important; }

rules: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing-photo-left { transform: translateY(var(--closing-left,0px)); opacity: var(--closing-left-opacity,1); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing-photo-right { transform: translateY(var(--closing-right,0px)); opacity: var(--closing-right-opacity,1); }
body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-closing .bms-heading { clip-path: inset(0 calc(100% - var(--closing-reveal,100%)) 0 0); color: white; }

children: body.home .bms-motion-on .bms-panel-background img { top: 0px; height: 100%; transform: none; }
body.home #offcanvas .ct-panel-inner { inset: 80px 24px auto auto; width: calc(100% - 48px); height: auto; max-height: calc(-100px + 100svh); min-height: 0px; border-radius: 24px; overflow: auto; }
body.home .bms-focus-split { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; padding: 28px 24px 36px; }
body.home .bms-closing { min-height: 560px; padding: 65px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
body.home .bms-focus-visual img, body.home .bms-focus-copy { transform: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
body.home .bms-focus-card, body.home .bms-panel-background img, body.home .bms-closing-photo { transform: none !important; }
body.home a:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .bms-roll > span:first-child { transform: none; opacity: 1; }
